title: Logarithmic Gaussian scale identity
statement: For $0<\rho<1$, define $s=(1-\rho)/\sqrt{1-\rho^2}$ and $C=e^{-3/2}s/\bigl((1+s^2)2\pi\bigr)$. For every $t>0$, \[\log\!\left(C\frac{e^{-t^2/(1+\rho)}}{t^2}\right)=\log C-\frac{t^2}{1+\rho}-2\log t.\]
